# Vidusha Sanidu - Academic & Research Portfolio

> Vidusha Sanidu is a Computer Science Researcher and AI Engineer specializing in Federated Learning (FL), Privacy-Preserving Machine Learning, Differential Privacy, Distributed Edge Intelligence, and Healthcare Decision Support. He is affiliated with the University of Peradeniya (UOP), Sri Lanka.

## Academic & Institutional Affiliation
- **Institution**: University of Peradeniya (UOP), Sri Lanka
- **Department**: Department of Statistics & Computer Science, Faculty of Science
- **Degree**: B.Sc. (Hons) in Computer Science (2021 – 2025), Second Class (Upper Division), GPA: 3.67 / 4.00
- **Current Role**: Research Assistant @ University Research Council (URC), UOP
- **Status**: Open to academic research collaborations, preprints, and graduate opportunities (M.Sc. / Ph.D.)

## Research Pillars
1. **Distributed Artificial Intelligence**: Decentralized optimization methods, multi-agent coordination, and aggregation algorithms under client heterogeneity.
2. **Privacy-Preserving & Personalized Federated Learning**: Rigorous privacy guarantees via Differential Privacy (DP), secure aggregation, and client-specific personalization.
3. **Machine Learning in Healthcare & Medical Decision Support**: Ensemble learning and predictive modeling for clinical datasets, including hemodialysis management and diagnostic workflows.
4. **Distributed Computing & Edge Intelligence**: Optimizing on-device computation, memory constraints, and asynchronous communication across resource-constrained edge devices.

## Key Publications & Preprints
- **Journal Submission (2026)**: *Socially-Aware Pedestrian Trajectory Prediction System Using Federated Learning*
  - **Authors**: Vidusha Sanidu, Prof. Saluka Kodithuwakku
  - **Venue**: Ceylon Journal of Science
  - **Contribution**: Introduced the Lightweight Social Interaction-Aware Transformer (Light-SIAT) integrating a Transformer encoder and Graph Convolutional Network (GCN). Achieved 0.32m ADE on ETH/UCY benchmarks (~14% improvement over FedAvg) under non-IID conditions with strict privacy guarantees.
- **Research Manuscript in Preparation (2026)**: *Optimized Federated Edge AI Framework with Image Processing for Speed Prediction in Semi-Automated Electric Vehicles*
  - **Authors**: Vidusha Sanidu, Dr. Erunika Dayaratna
  - **Focus**: Real-time edge speed prediction and computer vision processing under decentralized privacy constraints for semi-automated electric vehicles.

## Select Engineering Projects
- **EchoIC**: AI-powered voice cloning and analysis platform with asynchronous queue processing and Cloudflare R2 storage. (https://echo-ic.com)
- **AI Assistant & Study Planner**: RAG-powered student advisor built for TPT School (Florida, USA) using Google Gemini and FastAPI. (https://chatbot.tngs.es)
- **Road Tax Me**: UK vehicle road tax management platform integrated with DVLA API and Stripe. (https://www.roadtaxme.co.uk)
- **StudentMoves**: UK student accommodation portal with advanced property management and Stripe billing. (https://www.studentmoves.co.uk)
- **IT-Center UOP**: Student management and lab reservation system for University of Peradeniya IT Center. (https://www.ceit.pdn.ac.lk)
